title: Police Gave Her a 2nd Chance But She Ruined it
description:
This woman thought it was a good idea to sleep on the guardrail. Although the officers were friendly with her, they were completely unaware of the substance she had in her pocket. What seemed like a calm situation was soon about to go sideways. As soon as she was asked to leave the area, the woman walked into the middle of the road and began obstructing traffic. That’s when the officers dragged her to the sidewalk. She had a charred cylindrical pipe in her pocket, which was used to consume c*caine. The woman was charged with battery upon a peace officer.
